The whole or cut dried calyces and epicalyces of Hibiscus sabdariffa collected during fruiting. Profile Hibiscus is a large genus of flowering plants in the Malvaceae family. The flowers of roselle, Hibiscus sabdariffa, are included in herbal preparations for loss of appetite and a range of disorders of the upper respiratory and gastrointestinal tracts. Culinary uses of H. sabdariffa include hibiscus tea, a refreshing caffeine-free beverage made from the flowers.
